messages:
Alex: Quick sync — webinar traffic looked healthy but MQLs are ~22% lower than our forecast. Dashboard snapshot here: https://dash.redwood.com/weekly/webinar-03 — anyone else seeing the drop? :thinking:

Maria: Saw that too. Looks like a chunk of sessions show source=ref=unknown in the leads table. Might be some UTM parsing dropping.

Chris: I'm digging in. Pipeline events all landed but the dashboard cohort defaulted to `14d` for source attribution instead of `30d`. If the viz trimmed earlier touches that could explain a swing.

Taylor: Also noticed a conversion kink at Registration -> Confirm email. Conversion was 38% vs our normal ~52% for webinars. Could be an email send/relay timing issue.

DashboardBot: Dashboard refresh completed at 2026-03-22 10:12 UTC — cache TTL 10m.

Chris: Quick SQL to check utm presence (running now):
```sql
select count(*) as hits, utm_source, utm_medium
from leads_raw
where event_ts between '2026-03-20' and '2026-03-21'
group by utm_source, utm_medium
order by hits desc;
```

Alex: Nice. Can you run a recalc with the 30d attribution window and snapshot results? If it's a viz default bug we should update the dash and call out the change in the KPI notes. I can't own the fix today.

Maria: I can own the dashboard change. Chris — can you post the recalculated numbers here by EOD? I'll push an updated viz with the 30d default and add a changelog note.

Taylor: I'll triage the email confirm step with Platform/Deliverability — pinging @platform-ops to check send timings and bounce logs. Will report back in this thread.

Chris: Ran the recalc — preliminary numbers: MQLs with 14d attr = 712, with 30d attr = 913. Most of the delta is from `utm_campaign`-less organic follow-ups that got matched after 14d. I'll attach the CSV to the daily report. Will also patch the pipeline filter for the dashboard.

Alex: Perfect — thanks. For weekly KPI review (Friday), let's include a short section: "Webinar: initial dashboard view vs corrected attribution" with the adjusted MQLs and a note on the dashboard default. Maria, can you add a 1-slide summary to the deck?

Maria: Yup — I'll add a slide in the KPI deck under "Attribution & Dash updates" and mark the viz as corrected.

Taylor: Platform asked for the message IDs for the affected sends — I'm posting those in #platform-ops now. Will update here once they confirm.

Alex: Great. Owners: Maria (dashboard fix + KPI slide), Chris (recalc + CSV), Taylor (email triage). Follow-up sync if any of those items show further anomalies. :thumbsup:
